# truenas_nfs_config (Data Source)

Reads the current TrueNAS NFS service configuration. Takes no arguments: there is exactly one NFS configuration per TrueNAS system.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `allow_nonroot` (Boolean) Whether NFS client mount requests from unprivileged (non-root) ports are allowed.
- `bindip` (List of String) IP addresses the NFS service is bound to. Empty list means all addresses.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton: always "nfs_config".
- `keytab_has_nfs_spn` (Boolean) Whether the system keytab currently has an NFS service principal name.
- `managed_nfsd` (Boolean) Whether the NFS server daemon is currently managed/running.
- `mountd_log` (Boolean) Whether mountd logging is enabled.
- `mountd_port` (Number) TCP/UDP port used by mountd. 0 means the default (dynamic) port.
- `protocols` (List of String) NFS protocol versions served. One or more of NFSV3, NFSV4.
- `rdma` (Boolean) Whether NFS over RDMA is enabled.
- `rpclockd_port` (Number) TCP/UDP port used by rpc.lockd. 0 means the default (dynamic) port.
- `rpcstatd_port` (Number) TCP/UDP port used by rpc.statd. 0 means the default (dynamic) port.
- `servers` (Number) Number of NFS server threads. 0 means automatic thread management.
- `statd_lockd_log` (Boolean) Whether rpc.statd and rpc.lockd logging is enabled.
- `userd_manage_gids` (Boolean) Whether supplemental groups are resolved server-side (more than 16 groups).
- `v4_domain` (String) NFSv4 domain override for ID mapping. Empty string uses the system default.
- `v4_krb` (Boolean) Whether Kerberos is required for NFSv4 mounts.
- `v4_krb_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Kerberos is currently enabled/active for NFSv4.
